**ghz4.** Over 240 daily snapshots of real ibm_fez calibration data, a perfect tracker would have gained 0.0 % over the best fixed setting for ghz4 (arm 5, Z-R); the best setting changed significantly 8 times (9 epochs, median length 18 days; 30 raw argmax flips, ambiguous-day fraction 0.56). eps-greedy had the lowest dynamic pseudo-regret, 1.78 [0.94, 4.74], against 4.12 for the everything-on default and 0.04 for the static oracle (seeds 0–5, tuned on the same seeds).

**qft3.** Over 240 daily snapshots of real ibm_fez calibration data, a perfect tracker would have gained 0.0 % over the best fixed setting for qft3 (arm 5, Z-R); the best setting changed significantly 3 times (4 epochs, median length 62 days; 18 raw argmax flips, ambiguous-day fraction 0.62). eps-greedy had the lowest dynamic pseudo-regret, 3.36 [2.63, 5.18], against 4.26 for the everything-on default and 1.67 for the static oracle (seeds 10–10).

**Proxy validation (per day).** ghz4: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 46 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.88, median forward regret of the mirror pick 1 % of the worst arm's). grover3: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 94 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.93, median forward regret of the mirror pick 0 % of the worst arm's). qft3: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 29 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.62, median forward regret of the mirror pick 8 % of the worst arm's).

**Drivers.** ghz4: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.93 against a majority rate of 0.94; 5 of 8 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). ghz8: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.99 against a majority rate of 0.99; 0 of 2 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). grover3: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.98 against a majority rate of 0.97; 2 of 3 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). qaoa6: 0 of 0 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). qft3: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.95 against a majority rate of 0.95; 0 of 3 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51).
